metadata.title: [BUG][A2A]: Gateway drops task_id when proxying to A2A backend agents, breaking multi-turn conversations
metadata.author: nikdvy

description:
## Problem

When ContextForge proxies requests to A2A backend agents, it uses hardcoded values:
- JSONRPC `id` field: always `1`
- `messageId`: `f"admin-test-{int(time.time())}"` (new value each call)

This means backend agents **cannot correlate messages into a conversation session**. Even if the client sends `task_id` in parameters, it gets dropped by the gateway.

## Impact

Stateful A2A agents (e.g. using LangGraph with Redis checkpointer) rely on `task_id` as `thread_id` to maintain conversation history. Without task_id forwarding, every request through ContextForge creates a new isolated conversation — multi-turn dialogs are impossible.

## Expected Behavior

If the client includes `task_id` or `taskId` in the request parameters, the gateway should forward it to the backend agent in:
1. The JSONRPC `id` field
2. The `message.task_id` field (for agents that use it as thread identifier)

When `task_id` is not provided, current behavior should be preserved (backward compatible).

## Affected Code

- `mcpgateway/services/a2a_service.py` — `invoke_agent()` line ~1398
- `mcpgateway/services/tool_service.py` — MCP→A2A bridge lines ~3869, ~4947

## Reproduction

1. Register an A2A agent that uses conversation history (e.g. LangGraph + Redis checkpointer with `thread_id`)
2. Send two messages with the same `task_id` through the gateway
3. Observe that the backend agent receives different IDs each time → no conversation continuity

## Proposed Fix

Extract `task_id`/`taskId` from inbound parameters and include it in the outbound JSONRPC payload. Falls back to existing behavior when not provided.

comments.author: nikdvy
comments.body:
Closing: investigated the latest main and this has been resolved in the recent refactor. `mcpgateway/services/a2a_protocol.py:build_a2a_jsonrpc_request()` now:
- Extracts `id` from client parameters (line 312: `request_id = payload.pop("id", 1)`)
- Forwards client-provided `messageId` (line 329)
- Falls back to UUID-based messageId when not provided (line 294)

Backend A2A agents can now receive stable identifiers for multi-turn conversations when the client includes `id` or `messageId` in the request parameters.
